title: Lovastatin and Its ß-hydroxy Acid From Four 600 mg LipoCol Forte® Capsules Compared to That of One 20 mg Mevacor® Tablet in Healthy Subjects

sections.abstract: The objective of the study is to evaluate the relative bioavailability of lovastatin and its ß-hydroxy acid of 600 mg LipoCol Forte® Capsules compared to that of one 20 mg Mevacor® Tablet after single oral administration in healthy subjects using a 2x2 crossover design.
